items.s: Implementation of the Sea Cargo Manifest and Transshipment Regulations (SCMTR), 2018
items.sum: The old export manifest messages will be switched off zone by zone, with SCMTR messages becoming mandatory: Thiruvananthapuram from 16 Nov 2026, Chennai 7 Dec, Kolkata 14 Dec, and Delhi, Ahmedabad (incl. Mundra) and Mumbai zones from 6 Jan 2027, with the transition complete by 31 Jan 2027. Custodians, terminals and trans-shippers must move to SCMTR-compliant software. No penal action during this implementation phase.
items.who: Shipping lines, agents, terminals, CFSs/ICDs, exporters

items.s: The Sea Cargo Manifest and Transshipment (Fourth Amendment) Regulations, 2026
items.sum: Amends the SCMTR, 2018 (the rules for sea cargo manifests and transshipment). It is read together with Circular 47/2026-Customs, which sets the zone-wise dates for moving export manifest filing to SCMTR.

items.s: Mandatory filing under SCMTR, 2018: discontinuation of Supplementary IGM/EGM filing with effect from 12.08.2026
items.sum: For ICD Tughlakabad, supplementary IGM and EGM filings in the old format are discontinued; manifest amendments must be filed under SCMTR.
items.who: Shipping lines, agents, CFS operators and customs brokers at ICD TKD
